expected_level_description: You can: - manage a caseload of complex cases, advising hearing panels on fair outcomes - carry out or lead investigations, including those linked to incidents or safeguarding - use early resolution and mediation to settle disputes before they escalate - spot trends in cases and act on their causes

You can: - interpret employment law and policy for complex cases and advise on risk - draft and review people policies, with equality impact assessments - consult on policy changes with staff representatives

You can: - lead organisational change for a directorate, from business case to implementation - consult with staff and their representatives and respond to their feedback - manage the legal and equality risks of a change

You can: - apply pay rules, such as starting salary, protection, and allowances - check job descriptions are complete before they go to evaluation - take part in job evaluation panels as a trained member
You can: - run standard workforce reports and check them for errors - answer routine information requests about the workforce

You can: - work with the team to develop and maintain an understanding of stakeholders - work with the team to develop and implement stakeholder communications strategies - identify and resolve issues, influence stakeholders and manage relationships effectively - build long-term strategic relationships and communicate clearly and regularly with stakeholders
You can: - supervise day-to-day work and give feedback - take part in recruitment and induction - hold regular one-to-one conversations
You can: - carry out equality impact assessments - build inclusive teams and practices

You can: - explain the clinical and care workflows your work supports - use common health care terms correctly with clinical and care colleagues - recognise when a change could affect patient care and raise it
